items.q: just he and Vic Dickerson and a rhythm section and myself... On this particular occasion I sang some things with Bobby Hackett and Vic Dickerson.

ctx.x: Right, which I like. Well, I did the arrangement - well, when I first went out with The World's Greatest Jazz Band, after I finished the engagement at the River Boat with Bobby, just he and Vic Dickerson and a rhythm section and myself, and following that engagement I went to the Down Beat with The World's Greatest Jazz Band. Well you know the World's Greatest Jazz Band started out with about nine or ten pieces. But after we went to Europe the first time we went with the full band. You know it costs allot of…
